hooks.command: m=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)/..; for p in node_modules/.bin/pullboard "$m/node_modules/.bin/pullboard"; do [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" hook SessionStart; done; command -v pullboard >/dev/null || exit 0; exec pullboard hook SessionStart

m=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)/..; for p in node_modules/.bin/pullboard "$m/node_modules/.bin/pullboard"; do [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" hook Stop; done; command -v pullboard >/dev/null || exit 0; exec pullboard hook Stop

m=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)/..; for p in node_modules/.bin/pullboard "$m/node_modules/.bin/pullboard"; do [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" hook SessionEnd; done; command -v pullboard >/dev/null || exit 0; exec pullboard hook SessionEnd
